# surface: help__goals
# argv: sila goals --help
# mode: help
# exit: 0
--- stdout ---
sila goals  -  audit goals roadmap matrix, manage claim locks, match git commits, and trigger Plannotator

Usage
  sila goals [options]
  sila goals list [--status=implemented|pending|ready|blocked|claimed] [--json] [--toon]
  sila goal view <slug|index> [--json] [--toon]                (alias: sila goals view/show)
  sila goals create <slug> [--title="..."] [--desc="..."] [--depends-on="..."] [--independent] [--seq=N] [--template-dir=path]
  sila goals update <slug> [--title="..."] [--desc="..."] [--depends-on="..."] [--add-dep="..."] [--remove-dep="..."] [--independent] [--dependent] [--seq=N]
  sila goals depend <slug> [add|remove|set|clear] [<dep...>]
  sila goals contract <link|unlink|status|check|waive> [--session=<id>] [--goal=<slug>] [--json]
  sila goals certify <slug> [--auto-run | --evidence=<file>] [--agent=<name>] [--note="..."]
  sila goals audit <slug> [--evidence=<file>] [--agent=<name>] [--note="..."]
  sila goals test <slug> [--json] [--toon]
  sila goals import <slug> [--from=<dir>]
  sila goals claim <slug> [--agent=<name>] [--note="..."] [--force]
  sila goals focus <slug> --session=<id> [--agent=<name>] [--note="..."] [--force]
  sila goals touch <slug> [--agent=<name>]
  sila goals reopen <slug> [--reason="..."] [--agent=<name>] [--claim]
  sila goals report <slug> "<progress note>"
  sila goals commit <slug> -m "<commit-message>" [--no-build]
  sila goals attribute <slug> --commit=<hash>                  (attribute completed goal to git commit)
  sila goals release <slug>
  sila goals release --stale [--older-than=72h] [--dry-run] [--global]
  sila goals prune --claims [--dry-run] [--global]
  sila goals ready
  sila goals independent
  sila goals blocked
  sila goals claimed (alias: sila goals active)
  sila goals implemented
  sila goals pending
  sila goals global [--ready|--pending|--claimed]
  sila goals global stats [--json] [--toon]                    (tabular stats: ready, WIP, blocked, done)
  sila goals stats [--global] [--json] [--toon]                (project or global goals statistics)
  sila goals stats --line [--global]                           (one sidebar line: Ready, WIP, Blocked, Done)
  sila goals stats live [--interval=<duration>] [--full] [--global]   (refresh until Ctrl-C; replaces watch)
  sila goals tasks <slug>
  sila goals task <slug> check|uncheck <index>
  sila goals review [<slug>]

Commit Attribution
  A goal closes from a reachable commit containing `(goals/<slug>/goal.md)` or `Goal: <slug>`
  with a feat, fix, refactor, perf, or chore subject. docs and test commits are ignored,
  and pending goals list any skipped candidate commits so you can see why one did not close.

Options
  -p, --project=<dir>      Scope goals audit to a specific project directory
  --stats                  Display tabular goals statistics (ready, WIP, blocked, done, total)
  --title=<text>           Custom human-readable title for goal creation
  --desc=<text>            Goal description or summary (alias: --description)
  --depends-on=<slugs>     Comma-separated goal slugs this goal depends on (alias: --deps)
  --add-dep=<slugs>        Comma-separated goal slugs to add as dependencies (alias: --add)
  --remove-dep=<slugs>     Comma-separated goal slugs to remove from dependencies (alias: --remove)
  --by=<slug>              Superseding goal slug or reference (goals supersede)
  --evidence=<file>        Evidence report or test log file to certify a goal (goals certify)
  --from=<dir>             Source directory containing Plannotator artifacts (goals import)
  --independent            Explicitly mark goal as independent/disjoint
  --dependent              Explicitly mark goal as dependent on prerequisites
  --seq=<N>                Recommended sequence index for execution (alias: --sequence)
  --agent=<name>           Agent identifier for goal claim (default: $SILA_AGENT or agent)
  --session=<id>           Agent session id bound to a goal; read back with `sila goals active --session=<id> --json` (goals focus/claim/active)
  --note=<msg>             Progress note or status message for claim/report
  -m, --message=<msg>      Commit message for two-stage goal commit (goals commit)
  --no-build               Skip target binary rebuild during two-stage goal commit (goals commit)
  --reason=<text>          Reopening reason or remediation explanation (goals reopen)
  --claim                  Immediately claim goal upon reopening (goals reopen)
  --force, -f              Force override an existing active goal claim or overwrite existing goal package
  --stale                  Release claims whose recorded process is gone or inactive (goals release)
  --older-than=<age>       Minimum claim age for --stale (default 72h, e.g. 48h or 3d)
  --claims                 Prune claim records left on implemented or superseded goals (goals prune)
  --dry-run                Preview --stale releases or claim pruning without changing anything
  --all                    Show full uncapped history of implemented goals alongside active goals
  --no-sync                Preview the human matrix without reconciling goals/README.md
  --ascii                  Use stable ASCII tags and #/- progress bars (alias: --plain)
  --implemented            Only list verified implemented goals (alias: --done)
  --ready                  Only list unblocked goals ready to execute now
  --independent            Only list disjoint / parallelizable goals
  --blocked                Only list goals blocked by unmet prerequisites
  --claimed                Only list in-progress / claimed goals
  --pending                Only list unclaimed goals
  --status=<state>         Filter goals by state: implemented, pending, ready, independent, blocked, claimed, all
  --global                 Audit goals across all registered repositories
  --toon                   Emit compact Token-Oriented Object Notation on stdout
  --json                   Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout
  --no-color               Disable colored terminal output

Conversational
  sila list goals                              (query - auto)
  sila show goals                              (query - auto)
  sila do "release goal <slug>"                (destructive - sila do; use 'sila do "release goal <slug>"')

Safety
  Tier: destructive (interactive confirmation or --yes/--force required).
  Precedence: canonical-first; overlapping phrases require 'sila do "<phrase>"'.
  Phrase preview: pass --dry-run to a conversational phrase for a central preview without writing.
  Secrets are not accepted in positional arguments.
